prerequisites.text: At https://developer.spotify.com/dashboard, an application form is shown, behind a sign-in or an access request. Fields visible: email, privacy policy, terms of service.
prerequisites.label: Tested
prerequisites.note: observed by the agent at 2026-10-30T10:26:57Z, HTTP 200; matched login, continue with google, continue with apple

prerequisites.text: The app owner must hold an active Spotify Premium account.
prerequisites.label: Sourced
prerequisites.quote: The app owner must have a Spotify Premium account for apps in development mode to function.

prerequisites.text: You must accept the Spotify Developer Terms of Service when registering an app.
prerequisites.label: Sourced
prerequisites.quote: put a tick in the Developer Terms of Service checkbox and finally click on CREATE.

setup_steps.text: Log in to the Spotify Developer Dashboard at developer.spotify.com/dashboard.
setup_steps.label: Sourced
setup_steps.quote: Login to the Spotify Developer Dashboard.

setup_steps.text: Click on the 'Create an App' button.
setup_steps.label: Sourced
setup_steps.quote: click on the Create an App button to open the following dialog box:

setup_steps.text: Enter an App Name and App Description, check the Developer Terms of Service checkbox, and click CREATE.
setup_steps.label: Sourced
setup_steps.quote: Enter an App Name and App Description of your choice (they will be displayed to the user on the grant screen)

setup_steps.text: On the app overview page, click on 'Edit Settings' (or 'Settings').
setup_steps.label: Sourced
setup_steps.quote: It is time to configure our app. Click on Edit Settings to view and update your app settings.

setup_steps.text: Enter your callback addresses into the 'Redirect URIs' field and click SAVE.
setup_steps.label: Sourced
setup_steps.quote: In Redirect URIs enter one or more addresses that you want to allowlist with Spotify.

setup_steps.text: Obtain your Client ID and Client Secret (accessible under 'View client secret') to use in your application.
setup_steps.label: Sourced
setup_steps.quote: The Client ID can be found here. The Client Secret can be found behind the View client secret link.

setup_steps.text: To allow team members or testers to use the app in Development Mode, open the 'Users Management' tab, click 'Add new user', and enter their name and Spotify email address.
setup_steps.label: Sourced
setup_steps.quote: Tap on the Add new user button and enter the name and Spotify email address of the user that you want to enable

scopes.text: user-read-private: Read access to user subscription details and account type.
scopes.label: Sourced
scopes.quote: Read access to user’s subscription details (type of user account).

scopes.text: user-read-email: Read access to the user's email address.
scopes.label: Sourced
scopes.quote: Read access to user’s email address.

scopes.text: playlist-read-private: Read access to a user's private playlists.
scopes.label: Sourced
scopes.quote: Read access to user's private playlists.

scopes.text: playlist-modify-public: Write access to manage a user's public playlists.
scopes.label: Sourced
scopes.quote: Write access to a user's public playlists.

scopes.text: user-read-playback-state: Read access to the user's player state and Spotify Connect devices.
scopes.label: Sourced
scopes.quote: Read access to a user’s player state.

scopes.text: user-modify-playback-state: Write access to control playback across user clients and devices.
scopes.label: Sourced
scopes.quote: Write access to a user’s playback state

limits_before_approval.text: Development mode apps are limited to a maximum of 5 authenticated Spotify users.
limits_before_approval.label: Sourced
limits_before_approval.quote: Up to 5 authenticated Spotify users can use an app that is in development mode

limits_before_approval.text: Each user must be manually added to the app allowlist before they can use it.
limits_before_approval.label: Sourced
limits_before_approval.quote: Each Spotify user who installs your app will need to be added to your app's allowlist before they can use it.

limits_before_approval.text: Requests made using tokens from non-allowlisted users return a 403 Forbidden status code error.
limits_before_approval.label: Sourced
limits_before_approval.quote: However, API requests with an access token associated to that user and app will receive a 403 status code error.

limits_before_approval.text: Requests are restricted by quota buckets that limit requests across all development mode apps for a developer account.
limits_before_approval.label: Sourced
limits_before_approval.quote: Endpoints are grouped into quota buckets and requests to endpoints in the same bucket count toward a shared limit.

limits_before_approval.text: Developers are capped at creating up to 25 apps per developer account.
limits_before_approval.label: Sourced
limits_before_approval.quote: You can create up to 25 apps per developer account.

approval_process.text: Only legally registered organizations, not individual developers, can apply for extended quota access.
approval_process.label: Sourced
approval_process.quote: Please note that as of May 15th 2025, Spotify only accepts applications from organizations (not individuals).

approval_process.text: An initial partner application must be submitted through a company email via Spotify's designated form.
approval_process.label: Sourced
approval_process.quote: Application must be sent through a company email by using this form.

approval_process.text: Once a partner application is approved, developers submit a 4-step questionnaire under the 'Quota extension Request' tab in app settings.
approval_process.label: Sourced
approval_process.quote: Tell us about your app by filling out the provided questionnaire (4 steps)

approval_process.text: The Spotify app review team tests the app and delivers feedback by email to the app owner's registered address.
approval_process.label: Sourced
approval_process.quote: The app review team will review the information that you have provided, test out your app and send you feedback by email

approval_process.text: The quota extension review process takes up to six weeks.
approval_process.label: Sourced
approval_process.quote: This review process can take up to six weeks.

likely_blockers.text: Individual developers cannot apply; applicant must be an established business entity with a company email.
likely_blockers.label: Sourced
likely_blockers.quote: Please note that as of May 15th 2025, Spotify only accepts applications from organizations (not individuals).

likely_blockers.text: Extended quota applicants must maintain an active, launched service with at least 250,000 monthly active users (MAUs).
likely_blockers.label: Sourced
likely_blockers.quote: Maintaining a minimum of active users (at least 250k MAUs)

likely_blockers.text: The developer account owner must have a Spotify Premium account or development mode apps will not function.
likely_blockers.label: Sourced
likely_blockers.quote: The app owner must have a Spotify Premium account for apps in development mode to function.

likely_blockers.text: The applicant must operate an active, launched service available in key Spotify markets.
likely_blockers.label: Sourced
likely_blockers.quote: Operating an active, and Launched Service

likely_blockers.text: Requires privacy policy or terms URLs
likely_blockers.label: Inferred
likely_blockers.note: rubric modifier: noted as a blocker, it does not change the difficulty level

agent_can_do: Explain Spotify OAuth flows, scopes, and API endpoint specifications.
Draft code to exchange authorization codes or client credentials for access tokens.
Help construct redirect URIs and API request payloads.
you_must_do: Log in to the Spotify Developer Dashboard with a Spotify Premium account.
Register the application and accept the Developer Terms of Service.
Add your redirect URIs and copy the Client ID and Client Secret.
Add test users to the Users Management allowlist by Spotify account email.
Submit an organization partner application if public release (Extended Quota Mode) is required.

open_questions.text: What specific request numbers and time windows define the shared limit for each development mode quota bucket?
open_questions.label: Sourced
open_questions.quote: The specific groupings and limits are subject to change.
